content.title: AITWIRE vs Athena HQ
content.intro:
AITWIRE is the more complete solution for businesses that need to manage how AI systems represent them — not just monitor the problem, but actively fix it. Where most tools stop at reporting, AITWIRE closes the loop: it probes 13 AI systems, scores accuracy, generates corrective AI Signals, publishes them in machine-readable formats, and verifies that corrections are being adopted. That full cycle — measure, correct, verify — is what separates AI Representation Management from simple AI monitoring.

Athena HQ approaches the AI visibility problem from a sales and marketing intelligence angle, helping revenue teams understand how AI-driven buying signals and account intent data can inform outreach. It is a capable tool for its intended use case, but it does not address whether AI systems are describing your brand accurately, nor does it offer any mechanism to correct or improve that representation. For businesses whose concern is what AI says about them — not just who is searching — AITWIRE is the purpose-built choice.
content.competitor_description: Athena HQ is an AI-powered sales intelligence and account-based marketing platform targeting B2B revenue teams. Its core offering centers on surfacing buyer intent signals, enriching account data, and helping sales and marketing teams prioritize outreach based on AI-detected buying behavior. Athena HQ's approach is inbound-signal-focused: it tells your team who might be ready to buy, drawing on AI to process and rank account activity. It does not monitor how third-party AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) describe or recommend your brand, and it has no capability to publish corrective signals to those systems.

feature_table.tenant: Measures, corrects, and verifies how AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and 8 others) represent your brand — then publishes corrective AI Signals to improve that representation.
feature_table.competitor: Surfaces AI-powered buyer intent signals and account intelligence to help B2B sales and marketing teams prioritize outreach.

feature_table.tenant: 13 AI systems covering 90%+ of AI search and answer traffic, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok.
feature_table.competitor: Uses AI internally to process intent data; does not monitor or probe third-party AI systems for brand representation. (varies / verify)

feature_table.tenant: Generates corrective AI Signals from canonical brand facts and publishes them so AI systems learn accurate information. Automated counter-signals available on Custom plan.
feature_table.competitor: No correction capability for third-party AI representation. Platform does not address what AI systems say about your brand. (varies / verify)

feature_table.tenant: Publishes machine-readable AI Signals to help AI crawlers and language models discover and adopt correct brand facts. Verified through follow-up probes.
feature_table.competitor: No signal publishing to external AI systems. Output is internal dashboards and sales team alerts. (varies / verify)

feature_table.tenant: Four tiers: Free (quarterly assessment), Standard (monthly agent cycle, CAD $49/mo), Pro (weekly cycles + competitor monitoring, CAD $399/mo), Custom (daily cycles, unlimited competitors, AI Attribution, AI Lead Generation, Agentic Commerce).
feature_table.competitor: Pricing and plan structure not publicly listed; typically enterprise-quoted for B2B sales teams. (varies / verify)

feature_table.tenant: Transparent, published pricing starting at CAD $0 (Free), CAD $49/mo (Standard), CAD $399/mo (Pro), and Custom enterprise pricing.
feature_table.competitor: Pricing not publicly disclosed; requires sales engagement. (varies / verify)

feature_table.tenant: Re-probes AI systems after signal publication to verify corrections are being adopted. Drift detection alerts when AI representation changes unexpectedly.
feature_table.competitor: No verification loop for AI brand representation. Intent signal accuracy is internally validated but not independently verifiable against AI outputs. (varies / verify)

feature_table.tenant: Probes 13 AI systems; Custom plan includes AI Attribution and Agentic Commerce integrations. Machine-readable signal publishing connects to AI crawler infrastructure.
feature_table.competitor: Integrates with CRM and marketing automation tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) for sales workflow; no AI system integrations for brand representation. (varies / verify)

differentiators: AITWIRE is the only platform that completes the full correction loop — probe, score, correct, publish, and verify — rather than stopping at a report or dashboard.
AITWIRE monitors 13 named AI systems covering 90%+ of AI answer traffic, giving brands visibility into the specific systems their customers are actually using to research purchases.
AITWIRE's transparent, tiered pricing (starting free) lets independent brands and enterprises alike access AI representation management without a sales call or enterprise contract.
AITWIRE's drift detection and continuous monitoring (Pro and Custom plans) alert brands within hours when AI systems start misrepresenting them — before that misinformation influences buyers.

AITWIRE's Custom plan adds AI Attribution and AI Lead Generation, connecting corrected AI representation directly to revenue outcomes — a capability Athena HQ addresses from the opposite, unverified direction.

pros: End-to-end platform: monitors, corrects, publishes, and verifies AI representation in a single product.
Covers 13 AI systems including all major consumer and enterprise AI assistants.
Transparent, accessible pricing with a free tier — no sales process required to get started.
Drift detection and continuous alerts (Pro/Custom) catch AI misrepresentation before it affects buyers.
Custom plan extends into AI Attribution, AI Lead Generation, and Agentic Commerce for revenue-stage use cases.
cons: AITWIRE is purpose-built for AI representation management; it is not a CRM, sales sequencing, or account-based marketing tool.
The broadest capabilities (daily cycles, unlimited competitor tracking, Agentic Commerce) require the Custom plan, which is enterprise-priced.

pros: Strong fit for B2B revenue teams that need AI-powered buyer intent signals and account prioritization.
Integrates into existing CRM and sales workflows (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.), reducing adoption friction for sales teams.
Established in the sales intelligence category with a focused, well-understood use case.
cons: Does not monitor, measure, or score how third-party AI systems represent your brand — the core problem AITWIRE solves.
No capability to publish corrective signals or influence what AI systems say about your business.
Pricing is not publicly disclosed, requiring a sales engagement before evaluating fit or cost.
No verification mechanism to confirm whether AI systems are accurately describing your products, pricing, or differentiators to prospective buyers.

content.summary: For any business that cares about what AI systems say about them — and wants to do something about it — AITWIRE is the stronger choice. It is the only platform that combines AI representation monitoring across 13 systems with active correction, machine-readable signal publishing, and verified proof that those corrections are working. Athena HQ is a credible tool for B2B sales teams focused on buyer intent and account prioritization, but it does not address AI representation at all. Consider Athena HQ only if your exclusive need is internal sales intelligence and account scoring, and you have no concern about how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or other AI systems are describing your brand to the buyers those systems influence.
